ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, framed by low-intensity (black) pixels along the posterior perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous central region. Low-intensity black border following the trailing edge topography. Scattered discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed across both lobes. A distinct vertical low-intensity linear cluster is visible at the central base near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; interior borders exhibit high-contrast black pigmentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with a high frequency of small-scale peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward trajectory originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, high-density textured clusters of dark pixels localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization). Small, yellowish-orange high-contrast circular spots are visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the lower-left and mid-right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips of the flukes; presence of small orange-toned focal lesions on the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips exhibit significant protrusion of dark, irregular biological growth (barnacles) that breaks the smooth geometric continuity of the fluke's silhouette.
